source.unit: value-keyed validation of remaining conditions; equal argument values merge before conditions are checked

formal.clause: §6.1 four field types and constructor/setter type validation
§9 states owner constructor mismatched field types report error without equality exception

prerequisites: Unmodified reference constructor and generic validator; bare direct owner constructor, not PBS input or a normal user name dialog.
Inputs are bounded ordinary integers or ordinary text; no custom equality/hash behavior.
No plugin wrappers or extra schema validation.
Other constructor fields are integers and dependencies for type validation are present.
comparison: The formal failure clause says a constructor field type mismatch raises an error. Source groups type conditions by argument value; equal values keep the later condition. A numeric name equal to later integer gender/language therefore loses its text requirement and is stored as an integer. The individual name setter still rejects numeric input because its single check cannot be masked.

contrasts.result: ArgumentError; name0 does not merge with later integer fields

cancel_exception_partial_commit: No interactive cancellation here. Rejected constructor input fails before all four field writes; accepted colliding input writes all four values unchanged. Individual name-setter rejection occurs before name mutation. No game/save execution or new transaction guarantee is asserted. Existing owner input in creature creation is accepted as the owner record; malformed internal name is not recursively rejected there.

Record the bounded direct-constructor same-value counterexample as reference behavior: integer name0 with gender0 is accepted and stored; name0 with gender1 is rejected; later setter name0 is rejected.
